exam.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with two or more years designing and implementing AWS solutions and providing guidance across multiple applications/projects. Practice enterprise requirement decomposition, multi-account identity/governance, hybrid/global networking, security, distributed reliability, DR, deployment, performance/cost analysis, observability, portfolio assessment, migration mechanics, modernization and decommissioning.

review.notes: The current four-domain SAP-C02 guide was reconciled with every detailed domain page, the live 180-minute/75-question/USD-300 certification page, non-exhaustive service list and separately labeled unscored emerging topics. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 42 original checks cover enterprise connectivity/DNS, identity/governance, security, resilience, cost, distributed design, deployment, evidence-led improvement, portfolio migration/7Rs/waves, transfer mechanics, modernization and decommissioning. All 18 URLs are cataloged; automated link totals are updated from the source-health run. Current metadata is labeled, responsible/agentic-AI controls remain separated as possible unscored pretest content, and no recalled questions are used. September 17, 2026 delivery maintenance: checked the live AWS certification page and added the applicable language retirement or replacement-exam notice, including conflicting vendor dates where present. Existing objective snapshot and full-review dates remain unchanged. See docs/research/2026-09-17-exam-validation.md.
